## Design

### 2026-10-03 – I made silly designs for the PCB and overall schematic in this session, with help from Claude for creation of the symbol DAC1! I used net labels to handle wiring on the PCB later instead of on the sch

**8h**

I made silly designs for the PCB and overall schematic in this session, with help from Claude for creation of the symbol DAC1! I used net labels to handle wiring on the PCB later instead of on the schematic. Typical KiCAD starter here...

![Screenshot 2026-10-01 092445](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5L83T8pgt4C0kG6QB6wl2GpFHsDV2Xmw/e8b5cba2900fe5e5f4042cc52d6cd4bf0cbd1f8c60abd60d860c6a777d24f1d2.png)

Some issues I ran into today was with no connect symbols giving me a lot of errors in DRC, as can be seen here:

![Screenshot 2026-10-01 094100](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5L83T8pgt4C0kG6QB6wl2GpFHsDV2Xmw/531dbfe60682e7766093de0a08f007c985d257e259ceb31bb8d93fc0c18856f9.png)

They even gave a lot of grief when I was trying to REMOVE them until I realized you could just long click and have a context menu that you select the no connect symbol in -_- pfft

Making the traces was harder than expected, it looks like total wire spaghetti so I think I need to refine it next time:

![Screenshot 2026-10-01 121606](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5L83T8pgt4C0kG6QB6wl2GpFHsDV2Xmw/de4390e03755172d59108706e3205ff0ed1ada91c4f6b85d87ec3201c1f05d43.png)

I got a ground plane too made out of copper with 6 sides to provide some extra shielding for the audio circuitry (the red part you see with the traces outlined):

![Screenshot 2026-10-01 191329](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5L83T8pgt4C0kG6QB6wl2GpFHsDV2Xmw/e8969fd038be7346935372e8900ad52a21a445587866902ccb8c42cf9c498552.png)

I also had to fix up the text because I stupidly put it on the F.Cu layer, now it's on the F.Silkscreen layer instead! Very beautiful font work "KiCad Font" (it wouldn't let me choose another, kept complaining about thickness :P)

![Screenshot 2026-10-02 071528](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5L83T8pgt4C0kG6QB6wl2GpFHsDV2Xmw/4fb2bf6cb39275f8a6b33e4f2d79443e6a9d20c6a12fddaedeb91d900b60ec33.png)

I didn't know I had to create this project first on Half Life so... def downloading Lapse next time

I also put some mounting holes with a 2 mm size (M2 I think???) This is also when I realized the pinout with my symbol was wrong and I had to rotate the DAC connector and retrace it up 🥲

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5L83T8pgt4C0kG6QB6wl2GpFHsDV2Xmw/4b9ec9ec6fd4cc07bb131ee1ec4b8a85f3d70a601f220787699b3fc898f735f8.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-01 180228](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5L83T8pgt4C0kG6QB6wl2GpFHsDV2Xmw/161ae65884bbb6a6172799dce1de41690d1d858b4370cfc6844fbe2280862d16.png)

The design looks better than I would've ever expected though from a first circuit,

![Screenshot 2026-10-02 072512](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5L83T8pgt4C0kG6QB6wl2GpFHsDV2Xmw/769759bacb421f99440467d7f9c6d0b3c59c59ca70af337a9fce9656b98ce97c.png)

I'm ecstatic and I'll keep revising this in PCB week (oct 5). The next few hours I'll be doing basic software for the Pi Zero 2 W so I'm ready for when that time comes.
